prompt.en: A rectangle has length (x + 6) cm and width x cm. Its perimeter is 36 cm. What is x?

prompt.hi: एक आयत की लंबाई (x + 6) सेमी और चौड़ाई x सेमी है। उसका परिमाप 36 सेमी है। x कितना है?

hint.en: Perimeter = 2 × (length + width). Write it as an equation and solve.

prompt.en: Using π = 22/7, what is the area of a circle of radius 7 cm?

prompt.en: A right-angled triangle has legs 8 cm and 15 cm. What is the hypotenuse?

prompt.hi: एक समकोण त्रिभुज की दो भुजाएँ 8 सेमी और 15 सेमी हैं। कर्ण कितना है?

hint.en: Hypotenuse² = leg² + leg². Take the square root.
hint.mr: कर्ण² = बाजू² + बाजू². वर्गमूळ काढा.
hint.hi: कर्ण² = भुजा² + भुजा²। वर्गमूल निकालिए।

prompt.en: Using π = 22/7, what is the circumference of a circle of diameter 70 cm?

prompt.en: In a right-angled triangle the hypotenuse is 25 cm and one leg is 7 cm. How long is the other leg?

prompt.en: In a triangle two interior angles are 71° and 72°. What is the exterior angle at the third corner?

hint.mr: बाह्यकोन = दोन विरुद्ध आंतरकोनांची बेरीज.
hint.hi: बहिष्कोण = दो सम्मुख अंतःकोणों का योग।

prompt.en: A 19 cm by 12 cm rectangle has a 4 cm by 4 cm square cut out of it. What is the area left?

prompt.en: What is the total surface area of a cube with edge 4 cm?
